UML:TaggedValue.value: Oracle physical EA XMI 1.1 model aligned with Deposit Account Operations XML conventions: 2 packages, 11 tables with per-table CREATED_AT/CREATED_BY/RECORD_VERSION, UPDATE fields on mutable tables, first-class Oracle PK/FK/UNIQUE/INDEX/CHECK operations, change management and immutable audit. Existing 10 table and column EA GUIDs preserved from compact FCE XML. Includes data model only, no seed, no account, GL, loan schedules or collateral ownership. Cross-domain identifiers are service input codes. Overlapping version scopes and temporal exclusion require transactionally enforced service validations; physical CHECK constraints alone cannot express cross-row overlap.

Seven main entities: item, version, scope, rule, test, change-request, append-only audit. Physical constraints and system columns included.
